note: Mail and print facts for flyers, door hangers and postcards. USPS facts are from USPS pages; print sizes are common shop sizes, not rules, so members check their printer's template.

eddm.name: Every Door Direct Mail Retail
eddm.price_quote: EDDM Retail USPS Marketing Flats currently $0.26 per piece.
eddm.volume: At least 200 and up to 5,000 pieces per day per ZIP Code.
indicia_rules: Every EDDM mailpiece must include the EDDM Retail Indicia above and to the right of the address block.
The type font must be in all caps and at least a 4 point size.
eddm.indicia_placement: Keep the indicia in the top right corner, inside the area 1.625 inches from the right edge and 1.375 inches from the top, at least 1/8 inch from the edges.
prep: Bundle the pieces in stacks of 50 to 100, no taller than 6 inches.
Fill out and attach an EDDM facing slip to the top of every bundle.
Bring PS Form 3587 with the mailing.
Take the mailing to the Post Office for your selected ZIP Code.
Pay online with a card, or at the Post Office by cash, card or check.
eddm.tool_note: Use the route map on the EDDM page to pick carrier routes and see how many homes each has.

flats.rule: A flat is more than 11-1/2 inches long, or more than 6-1/8 inches high, or more than 1/4 inch thick, and no larger than 15 by 12 by 3/4 inches.
flats.eddm_ok_note: 6 x 9 is too small for EDDM: one side must be over 6-1/8 inches high or over 11-1/2 inches long. Check the USPS Mailpiece Size Checker before you print.

postcard.rule: A First-Class postcard is 3-1/2 to 4-1/4 inches high and 5 to 6 inches long, 0.007 to 0.016 inch thick.

mailbox_law.rule: Never put flyers, door hangers or anything unstamped in or on a mailbox. Federal law (18 U.S.C. 1725) bans unstamped mailable matter in mailboxes and can mean a fine. Hang it on the door handle or leave it at the door.

door_etiquette: Skip any home with a No Soliciting or No Flyers sign.
Check your city's rules for handbills before a big drop; some cities and HOAs limit them.
Go in daylight, stay on paths and driveways, and never open gates.
Hang it on the door handle or tuck it in the frame so it can't blow onto the lawn.

sizes.note: Common sizes at print shops and online printers. They're conventions, not rules: download your printer's template if it differs.

home_printing: Print at 100 percent (Actual size), not Fit to page.
Turn on Background graphics so the colors print.
Use heavy paper (cardstock, 65 lb or more) for door hangers, cards and signs.
Print one test page first and check the QR code with your phone camera.
